question: At the in-zone contacts of the six stored Stage-8 game files, was the action actually played the promotion move from the paid square, another move from that same square, or a move from a different square?

design.replay_precondition: terminal status, winner and ply count must equal the stored values
design.contact_definition: unchanged: in-zone paid square that is the from_square of a legal BoardMove with promotion_target_id not None
design.played_move_source: the stored move list of the same game, applied in order

nonclaims: the played move is not a counterfactual: nothing here shows the hand term caused a choice
no in-zone-versus-outside rate; the withdrawn 0-vs-53 contrast is not reproduced
no strength, playing-quality or utility claim
the contacts are availability events; an unplayed promotion there says nothing about search quality
